snippet.title: eFootball™ Kick-Off! / Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
eFootball™, reborn from PES, is now out on Nintendo Switch 2!
 
Experience the excitement of every goal – solo or with everyone!
Begin your football journey with Kick-Off!
 
Check out all the details here👇
https://www.konami.com/efootball/kick-off/us/en-us/
 
#eFootballKickOff
 
*The video released at launch has been partially revised and republished.
